item.title: HAX art
item.content:
Art and media from HAX: open-source tools that let anyone create, remix and publish on the web without needing to understand the web. This portfolio is itself a HAXsite, built with the HAX CLI, and every image on it is pulled straight from the haxtheweb/art repository.

Browse

  • World Traveler: the HAX mascot in every style
  • rpg-character: games and toys starring HAX's pixel character
  • Brand: logos, stickers, banners and posters
  • Talks: diagrams and explainers for presentations
  • Use the art: attribution, licensing and hotlinking

Dream it, remix it, have it, share it.
